content: Aarón, degi, e-masmala, Bab-Dummadga-arbaega nug-imaklesad
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Aarón, degi, e-masmalabo, anga dule-irwa-anse-gormaladga-gumalaga, weyob be imakoed:

content.text: Be-molimar-abargi moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwa-wargwen, degi, sibad-wawaad-machered-warbo be suoed.
Amar, swilidikid be suoed, bonikwasulid be suoed.

content: ”Deginbali, trigo-madubur-bur-nuedgi be we-madumar imakoed:
”We-madumala anse-gorleged-negse sedegala, garba-senigwadgi be urboed.

content.text: degi, sibad-wawaad-machered-warbogwad, anga ukega be sedoed.

content: ”Geb be, Aarón, degi, e-masmalamala, dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakse be sedoed. Agi be, Aarón, degi, e-masmala, be diigi ogoed.
”Geb degine, mor-efodʼye-nugad morgo-dub-sadergi-naguedgi ega be edinnoed.
Deginbali, mor-gurgin-ebirmakaled e-nonogi ega be sioed. We-mor-gurgin-ebirmakaled-birgi or-nued-matargwagwad-islidikid ega be nasikoed.
Geb degine, olivo-gwallu be suoed. Geb we-olivo-gwallu Aarón-nonogi be eogoed. Adi, dule-irwa-anse-goledga onugsalegegar.
”Deginbali, Aarón-e-masmala bese-dagega be imakmogoed. Geb, ega be mor-dummagan-maklesad yomogoed.

Degi, ega be gurgin simogoed. Deginbali, Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga nuekwa mor-dub-saderba-nagued be edinnoed. Weyobi, Aarón, degi, e-masmala, angarbi-arbamalaga be onugsaoed. Weyobi, dule-irwa-anga-goledga degisadegu gumaloed.
”A-sorbali, moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakse be sedoed. Geb Aarón, degi, e-masmala, we-moli-e-nono-birgi e-argan mesmaloed.
Geb agi, dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakgi be an-asabin we-moli oburgoed.

Geb we-moli-e-abe be suoed. Degine, we-abe be-googi anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi moli-bebegiid-gwichidgi be mage-mage imakoed. Geb degine, Abe-gwabgusaddi, bela ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-nagaba be eogoed.
Deginbali, bela we-ibmarmar be weoed:
”Geb a-gwallumala anga ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-birgi be ogumakoed.
Moli-bebe-nikad-e-sandi, e-ukadi, e-saadi, soogi dulemar-danar-danar-bukmalad-magaba be ogumakoed. Ar we-ibmardi isgued-anar uklegoed.
”Geb degine, sibad-wawaad-machered-warbogwad be wargwen suoed. ”Aarón, degi, e-masmala, a-sibad-e-nono-birgi e-arganmar mesmaloed.
We-sibad-wawaad-machered be oburgoed, degine, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-e-dikarmargi we-sibad-wawaad-e-abe be bomi-bomi imakoed.
We-sibad-wawaad be goamakoed. Geb e-samur, degi, e-malimar, nue be enukoed. Geb degine, wemar-enukaled e-nonoba, e-sanmar-goamakaledba, mesa be urboed.
Geb a-sorbali, sibad-wawaad-machered ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-birgi bela be ogumakoed. We-ibmar-ogumakar-anga-ukleged, an yeer-yapan itogoed. We anga soogi ogumakar uklenaid.
”Geb degine, sibad-wawaad-machered-baid be subaloed.

content.text: Aarón, degi, e-masmala, a-sibad-wawaad-e-nono-birgi e-arganmar mesmarbaloed.

content: ”Geb anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-e-dikarmargi we-abe be bomi-bomi imakbaloed.

Anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi-abe-siidi, degi, dule-nugsalenair-olivo-gwallu-ebulegedi, Aarónʼgi be bomi-bomi imakoed, degi, e-mormargi be bomi-bomi imakbaloed. Geb Aarón-e-masmalagi, degi, e-masmala-morgi be bomi-bomi imakbaloed. ”Weyobi, Aarón, e-mormala, e-masmala, degi, e-masmala-mormala, an-asabin anga islidiki guoed.
”Geb degine, we-sibad-wawaad-machered-e-gwallu be suoed:
”Deginbali, madu-e-inasurmalad garba-bipi-Bab-Dummad-asabin-siidgi be suoed:
”Bela we-madumala, Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga, be ukoed. Geb an-asabin bana-bana imakmaloed, adi, anga-ibmar-ukledaedga guegar.
”Geb a-sorbali, Aarón e-argangi-madumar-ganikid bega ukoed.
”Deginbali, be anga Aarón-anga-arbaega-onugsalegega, sibad-wawaad-machered-e-binasgar be suoed.

”Sibad-wawaad-machered-uklesad-e-binasgar anga-bana-bana-uklegaled, bachikii be imakoed, degi, e-dua-sabolesad anga-bana-bana-uklesad, bachikii be imakbaloed. Wemala, Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga uklegoed. Ar we-ibmarmar, Aarón, degi, e-masmala, anga-arbaega-onugsalenaidgi sulesad.
We-ibmarmala Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga uklegoed.
”Aarón-mormar-islidikmalad, anse-dule-irwa-gorsokalir-yoleged, Aarón-sorba, e-wagan sumaloed, adi, a-mormar-yoi anga dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga-nugsalemalagar.
Aarón-e-wagan-wargwen, e-bab-sorba dule-irwa-anse-golega-sulesar, anga Neg-Islidikidgi-arbaega, dulemar-anbo-ambikued-negse nonikile, we-mola yooed. Ibagugle (7) we-mola-yoi gudii guoed.
”Anga-arbaega-dule-onugsalesadgi sibad-wawaad-machered-uklegaled-e-sana be suoed. A-e-sana nega-islidikidgi be duoed.
Aarón, degi, e-masmala, we-sibad-wawaad-machered-uklegaled-e-san, degi, garbagi-madu-siid, dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg-yawagakgi gunmaloed.

We-ibmarmar-uklesadbali, an wemar isgussuliyob daknonikid, degi, anga-arbaega dule-irwa-golega-gumalaga nugsalesmalad. Degisoggu, we-ibmarmar Aarónʼbi, degi, e-masmalabi gunmaloed. Ar we-ibmarmar anga uklegaledsoggu, dule-baigandi gunnosurmalad.
We-sanmar-anga-uklegaled, degi, we-madumar-anga-uklegaled, obichale, be soogi ogumakoed. Ar we-ibmarmar ibmar-swilidikmaladsoggu, oibosadgine melle bar gunno.
”Degisoggu, an-bela-bega-sogsadba, deyob be, Aarón, degi, e-masmala be imakoed. Wemala anga-arbaega-onugsalegega, ibagugle (7) egi be arbaoed.

E-isgumalad-elilegegala, anga be bane-bane moli-bebe-nikad-sapingwagwad ukoed. Degidbali, ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila anga-uklegega guagwar signonikoed. We-aila anga-uklegoedi, olivo-gwallu egi be mage-mage imakoed.
Deyob isgued-elilegegala, degi, angadga-aila-guegala, ibagugle (7) be imakoed. Degine, deyob aila angadga sii guoed. Degi, ibu-ibmar we-aila-ebusale, bela-ibmar angadga gunonimogoed.”
Bane-bane Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uklegoed-Igar
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi bane-bane wemar be ukoed:

content.text: Degine, anga be egi vino, bute-wargwen-mergu eobaloed.

content: ”Anse-goled-neg-dogedgi an bebo-sunmakega bebo-abinguoedgi, be-wagan degisadegu, an-asabin, anga we-ibmar-ogumakar-ukmai gumaloed.
Deginbali, agi an, Israel-dulemarbo abingubaloed. A-nega, an-egi-gandikidba-gudii guoedbali, neg-islidikidga guoed.
”Dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neg, degi, anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila angadga an imakoed. Deginbali, Aarón, degi, e-masmala, angadga an imakbaloed, adi, dule-irwa-anse-gormaladga gumalagar.
Ani an Israel-dulemar-abargi gudii guoed, degine, e-Bab-Dummadga an gubaloed.
Adi, deyob Israel-dulemar wisgumaloed:
